title: Profile: Anthropic Messages API
goal: Content blocks, system prompts, stop reasons, streaming events, error types and headers (anthropic-version, beta flags). Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
